lead_detail: NML records show many crocodile mummies were 'Purchased from the collections of Norwich Castle Museum' in 1956 (56.21.512-518, 537, 545; 56.22.223; 56.22.405a-e). Check whether Norwich still holds any crocodile mummies (Kalloniatis 2019, The Egyptian Collection at Norwich Castle Museum. Catalogue and Essays, p. 15) and avoid double counting with Liverpool.
World Museum 1976.159.270 crocodile mummy 'Purchased From Cheltenham College' 1975; college museum sold material - check if other crocodile mummies went elsewhere.
Bio Bank blog: 'the collection includes 15 mummies including birds, crocodiles and mammals'.
Bio Bank blog shows an Oxford object card for a 'Mummy of baby crocodile' (institution implied as Ashmolean; verify).
